title: Anti-Pesto
format: Twelve signs, up to 24 × 36 in, coroplast and vinyl
summary: Signs that guide visitors through a village vegetable show and ask them, very politely, not to feed the rabbits.
coverAlt: Green directional signs among vegetable stalls at a village show

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: Design a temporary wayfinding system for an outdoor event of your choice.

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body: A vegetable show is a maze of stalls that changes every year. The system had to be cheap, quick to install, and readable from across a muddy field. Arrows and numbers do the work, and the illustrations add the warmth.

blocks.label: Site plan. The show layout with every decision point marked.

blocks.heading: Process
blocks.body: I walked the site with a clipboard and marked every place a visitor might stop and wonder. Each stop became a sign. Mockups at full size showed that the first type was too thin to read at thirty feet.

blocks.caption: Signs installed on the day of the show.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: No one got lost and no rabbits were harmed. Next year I would add a printed map, because older visitors asked for one.
